title: Timing DIO vectors lack independent envelope and checksum validation
description: The packets-timing authenticated DIO corpus is security-sensitive, but its independent test checks signatures and source/signer binding only. It does not verify that the stored SCHC dispatch wraps the exact IPv6 bytes, that IPv6 lengths/fields are coherent, that ICMPv6 checksums are valid except for the intentional negative, or that the DIO Time option span identifies the exact option. Add no-production-import checks over the envelope and each signed network case.
